features.name: Moderation & case history
features.description: Moderation actions create case history with member, moderator, reason, and timestamp.

features.name: Tickets with transcripts
features.description: Members open private support channels; closing creates a text transcript.

features.name: Leveling & rewards
features.description: Message activity earns configurable XP, levels, and milestone role rewards.

features.name: Giveaways & polls
features.description: Run persisted giveaways and interactive polls with optional role eligibility.

features.name: Autorole & reaction roles
features.description: Assign a role on join or let members choose from configured button panels.

features.name: Audit logging
features.description: Route moderation, server, activity, and command events to configured channels.

features.name: Announcements & DMs
features.description: Compose server announcements or send staff-directed member and role messages.

features.name: Autoresponders
features.description: Reply to configured message triggers using supported matching rules.

features.name: Games
features.description: Start button-based Tic-Tac-Toe, Rock-Paper-Scissors, and number guessing.
